text: The Toronto Parking Authority is seeking to obtain Board approval for emergency repairs to four (4) existing stairwells at Car Park 43, located at 2 Church Street. Car Park 43 was built in 1990, it is a six (6)-storey parking structure with 2008 spaces in the Saint Lawrence Market neighborhood. The garage includes an eight (8)-storey Toronto Community Housing building above the structure. Pre-pandemic (2019) gross revenues were $7.3M. Car Park 43 is consistently one of the top five (5) highest revenue-generating garages across our portfolio. As such, this investment is critical from a safety perspective and consistent with our strategy to reinvest in our infrastructure State of Good Repair capital and reduce reputational risk to our brand Paul Didur Architect Inc., was retained by Toronto Parking Authority in August 2021 to perform a condition assessment of the car park, and undertake…

The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Provided authority to the President, Toronto Parking Authority, to award the Construction Contract for the 5043-47 – Exit Stairwell Rehabilitation at 2 Church Street (Car Park 43) to Ritestart Limited, having submitted the lowest compliant bid and meeting all specifications in conformance with the Construction Tender requirements, in the amount of $4,330,389 plus $1,300,000 as a contingency allowance, being the sum total amount of $5,630,389 excluding Harmonized Sales Tax.
